examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A `Button` trigger that opens the popover. The panel content is composed by part — here a header (title + close) and a free-form body.

examples.name: Placements
examples.summary: The four vertical corners and the two inline sides (`side="end"`, `side="start"`) side-by-side; every side takes `align` `start`, `center` or `end`, and `start` / `end` follow the text direction. Click a trigger to open its panel and see how it anchors against the trigger.

examples.name: AutoPlacement
examples.summary: `side="auto"` lets the popover choose the side with the most room at open time. The four triggers below all use the same value. Click one to open its panel: each, anchored near a different viewport corner, resolves toward the side with the most available space.
